pl.description: Zwraca listę sesji z opcjonalnym filtrowaniem po datach i etykietami formatów.

queryParams.name: includeContent
queryParams.description: Wartość 'true' dołącza tekst opisu sesji do odpowiedzi.

queryParams.name: labels
queryParams.description: Wartość 'true' dołącza przetłumaczone etykiety formatów sesji (pole formatLabel).

en.description: Returns a list of sessions with optional date filtering and format label translations.

queryParams.name: includeContent
queryParams.description: Set to 'true' to include session content text in the response.

queryParams.name: labels
queryParams.description: Set to 'true' to include format label translations (adds formatLabel field to each session).

pl.description: Tworzy jedną lub wiele sesji w podanych plikach Markdown. Obsługuje tryb pojedynczy (płaskie pola w body) oraz tryb wsadowy (tablica sessions).

bodyFields.name: title
bodyFields.description: Tytuł sesji. W trybie wsadowym wymagany w każdym obiekcie w tablicy sessions.

bodyFields.name: narrator
bodyFields.description: Nazwa narratora prowadzącego sesję. W trybie wsadowym wymagany w każdym obiekcie w tablicy sessions.

bodyFields.name: date
bodyFields.description: Data sesji. Parsowana przez [datetime]::Parse. W trybie wsadowym wymagana w każdym obiekcie w tablicy sessions.

bodyFields.name: path
bodyFields.description: Ścieżka (lub tablica ścieżek) do docelowych plików .md, w których zostanie zapisany nagłówek sesji. W trybie wsadowym podawana na poziomie głównym body.

bodyFields.name: dateEnd
bodyFields.description: Data zakończenia sesji wielodniowej. Parsowana przez [datetime]::Parse.

bodyFields.name: metadataNarrators
bodyFields.description: Dodatkowi narratorzy sesji (oprócz głównego narratora).

bodyFields.name: locations
bodyFields.description: Lista odwiedzonych lokacji podczas sesji.

bodyFields.name: logs
bodyFields.description: Adresy URL do logów sesji.

bodyFields.name: content
bodyFields.description: Tekst opisu sesji wstawiany pod nagłówkiem.

bodyFields.name: pu
bodyFields.description: Przydziały PU (punktów umiejętności) dla postaci. Każdy element to obiekt z polami character (nazwa postaci) i value (wartość PU).

bodyFields.name: changes
bodyFields.description: Zmiany stanu encji przypisane do sesji. Każdy element to obiekt z polami entityName (nazwa encji) i tags (tablica obiektów {tag, value}).

bodyFields.name: intel
bodyFields.description: Dyrektywy wywiadowcze sesji. Każdy element to obiekt z polami rawTarget (cel) i message (treść wiadomości).

bodyFields.name: transfers
bodyFields.description: Transfery walutowe powiązane z sesją. Każdy element to obiekt z polami amount (kwota, domyślnie 1), denomination (waluta), source (źródło) i destination (cel).

bodyFields.name: sessions
bodyFields.description: Tryb wsadowy: tablica obiektów sesji. Każdy obiekt wymaga pól title, narrator i date oraz może zawierać opcjonalne pola (dateEnd, metadataNarrators, locations, logs, content, pu, changes, intel, transfers). Pole path podawane jest na poziomie głównym body.

en.description: Creates one or more sessions in the specified Markdown files. Supports single mode (flat body fields) and batch mode (sessions array).

bodyFields.name: title
bodyFields.description: Session title. In batch mode, required in each object within the sessions array.

bodyFields.name: narrator
bodyFields.description: Name of the narrator running the session. In batch mode, required in each object within the sessions array.

bodyFields.name: date
bodyFields.description: Session date. Parsed via [datetime]::Parse. In batch mode, required in each object within the sessions array.

bodyFields.name: path
bodyFields.description: Path (or array of paths) to the target .md files where the session header will be written. In batch mode, specified at the top level of the request body.

bodyFields.name: dateEnd
bodyFields.description: End date for multi-day sessions. Parsed via [datetime]::Parse.

bodyFields.name: metadataNarrators
bodyFields.description: Additional narrators for the session (beyond the primary narrator).

bodyFields.name: locations
bodyFields.description: List of locations visited during the session.

bodyFields.name: logs
bodyFields.description: URLs to session log resources.

bodyFields.name: content
bodyFields.description: Session description text inserted below the session header.

bodyFields.name: pu
bodyFields.description: PU (skill point) assignments for characters. Each element is an object with character (character name) and value (PU amount).

bodyFields.name: changes
bodyFields.description: Entity state changes associated with the session. Each element is an object with entityName (entity name) and tags (array of {tag, value} objects).

bodyFields.name: intel
bodyFields.description: Intel directives for the session. Each element is an object with rawTarget (target) and message (message text).

bodyFields.name: transfers
bodyFields.description: Currency transfers associated with the session. Each element is an object with amount (defaults to 1), denomination (currency), source, and destination.

bodyFields.name: sessions
bodyFields.description: Batch mode: array of session objects. Each object requires title, narrator, and date, and may include optional fields (dateEnd, metadataNarrators, locations, logs, content, pu, changes, intel, transfers). The path field is specified at the top level of the request body.

pl.description: Aktualizuje istniejącą sesję wskazaną przez { date, file } w ciele żądania. Metadane (locations, pu, logs, changes, intel) są zamieniane w całości — żeby dodać jeden element, klient MUSI wysłać kompletną nową tablicę. Format Gen2/Gen3 → Gen4 wymaga upgradeFormat=true.

bodyFields.name: date
bodyFields.description: Data sesji (YYYY-MM-DD) — identyfikator celu.

bodyFields.name: file
bodyFields.description: Ścieżka pliku sesji względem repo (np. sesje/2026.md) — identyfikator celu.

bodyFields.name: locations
bodyFields.description: Pełna lista lokacji sesji (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: pu
bodyFields.description: Pełna lista wpisów PU (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: logs
bodyFields.description: Pełna lista URLi logów (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: changes
bodyFields.description: Pełna lista wpisów @zmiany (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: narrator
bodyFields.description: Pełna lista narratorów.

bodyFields.name: intel
bodyFields.description: Pełna lista wpisów wywiadowczych.

bodyFields.name: content
bodyFields.description: Surowa zawartość Markdown sesji (zastępuje istniejącą).

bodyFields.name: dateOverride
bodyFields.description: Override pola @data w treści (np. dla retro-aktów).

bodyFields.name: upgradeFormat
bodyFields.description: Wymagane do konwersji Gen2/Gen3 → Gen4.

bodyFields.name: properties
bodyFields.description: Dodatkowe właściwości sesji (mają niższy priorytet niż jawne pola).

en.description: Updates an existing session identified by { date, file } in the body. Metadata arrays (locations, pu, logs, changes, intel) are full-replace — to add one element the caller MUST send the full intended array. Gen2/Gen3 → Gen4 conversion requires upgradeFormat=true.

bodyFields.name: date
bodyFields.description: Session date (YYYY-MM-DD) — target identifier.

bodyFields.name: file
bodyFields.description: Repo-relative session file path (e.g. sesje/2026.md) — target identifier.

bodyFields.name: locations
bodyFields.description: Full session locations list (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: pu
bodyFields.description: Full PU entry list (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: logs
bodyFields.description: Full log URL list (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: changes
bodyFields.description: Full @zmiany entry list (full-replace).

bodyFields.name: narrator
bodyFields.description: Full narrator list.

bodyFields.name: intel
bodyFields.description: Full intel entry list.

bodyFields.name: content
bodyFields.description: Raw session Markdown body (replaces existing).

bodyFields.name: dateOverride
bodyFields.description: Overrides the @data field in body (for retroactive edits).

bodyFields.name: upgradeFormat
bodyFields.description: Required for Gen2/Gen3 → Gen4 format conversion.

bodyFields.name: properties
bodyFields.description: Additional session properties (lower priority than explicit fields).
